project: Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks — PS2 Static Recompilation
approach: Static recompilation of the MIPS R5900 executable to C++20 on a patched PS2Recomp runtime (OpenGL GS renderer, native SPU2 engine, disc IRX modules in an R3000A interpreter), with game-specific overrides.
help: Midway SNDF sound bank upload (missing sound effects)
notes: Boots to the main menu: menus render cleanly, the controller works and the memory card is detected, menu music and announcer play (with crackle). 16:9 option. Character and difficulty select work; loading into a fight does not finish yet. Not playable.
